title: Vandenberg, Adams & Levin (2012) & Pinet et al. (2019) Picasso Tadpole Craniofacial Attractor Remodeling and Procrustes Target-Morphology Error Minimization

primary_papers.citation: Vandenberg LN, Adams DS, Levin M (2012) Normalized shape and location of perturbed craniofacial structures in the Xenopus tadpole reveal an innate ability to achieve correct morphology. Developmental Dynamics 241(5):863-878

Pinet K, Deolankar M, Leung B, McLaughlin KA (2019) Adaptive correction of craniofacial defects in pre-metamorphic Xenopus laevis tadpoles involves thyroid hormone-independent tissue remodeling. Development 146(14):dev175893
Pezzulo G, Levin M (2016) Top-down models in biology: explanation and control of complex living systems above the molecular level. Journal of the Royal Society Interface 13(124):20160555
Pai VP, Aw S, Shomrat T, Lemire JM, Levin M (2012) Transmembrane voltage potential controls embryonic eye patterning in Xenopus laevis. Development 139(2):313-323

governing_equations.procrustes_attractor_ode: dx_i/dt = eta_MMP * [ -K_i * (x_i - x_i^*) - sum_j C_ij * ((x_i - x_j) - (x_i^* - x_j^*)) ]
governing_equations.lyapunov_dissipation_rate: dV/dt = -eta_MMP * sum_i ||K_i (x_i - x_i^*) + sum_j C_ij ((x_i - x_j) - (x_i^* - x_j^*))||^2 <= 0
governing_equations.open_loop_fixed_displacement_null: dx_i^open/dt = (x_i^* - x_i^WT(0)) / T  ==>  x_i^open(T) - x_i^* = x_i(0) - x_i^WT(0) != 0

experimental_regimes.description: Unperturbed wild-type Xenopus laevis craniofacial remodeling from NF stage 45 tadpole to NF stage 65 froglet: lateral eyes migrate dorsomedially and rostrally while jaws and nares converge smoothly to the target froglet configuration X^*

Vandenberg, Adams & Levin (2012) surgical/teratogenic 'Picasso tadpole' with severely scrambled left eye (shifted caudally and medially), right eye (shifted rostrally and laterally), asymmetric nares, and laterally translocated jaw: closed-loop attractor dynamics reroute organ trajectories through novel paths to converge to X^* by NF stage 65

Vandenberg et al. (2012) unilateral caudal/dorsal eye translocation onto the posterior head/flank border: displaced left eye exhibits accelerated rostromedial velocity and catches up with the unperturbed contralateral right eye to restore bilateral symmetry
Vandenberg et al. (2012) lateral mouth/jaw displacement and naris rotation: off-midline jaw and nares migrate medially and anteriorly back to the midline target X^*

Vandenberg, Adams & Levin (2012) Fig. 1 open-loop hardwired displacement null hypothesis: each organ moves by its wild-type vector Delta_WT = x_i^* - x_i^WT(0) regardless of starting position, permanently preserving the initial Picasso scramble error ||Delta X(0)|| at NF stage 65

Pinet et al. (2019) matrix metalloproteinase (MMP) inhibition blockade (GM6001, eta_MMP = 0.04): suppressing ECM remodeling arrests adaptive craniofacial error correction in Picasso tadpoles, leaving severe residual Procrustes deformity
